title: 8 Taste Skill Lessons That Make Claude Code Design Better
description:
The Taste Skill is a design skill for coding agents with almost 117,000 GitHub stars, and its creator Leon Lin just shared his AI design workflow. I turn it into 8 lessons for Claude Code design: strong references, a target, a number to hit, time, a slop ban list, building in steps, clear feedback and a second judge. Then I show Cook, his free skill that runs it all as one loop.

👋 𝗛𝗲𝘆, 𝗜’𝗺 𝗘𝗿𝗶𝗰.
I'm a senior AI software engineer who worked at Amazon and Microsoft, and I'm building bookzero.ai with Claude Code.
